x-k-k6-01.title: Qabyo kee ayaa waayeelku oggolaan doonaa?
x-k-k6-01.goal: Ku xukun afar qabyo codsi erayadooda, oo sharax astaamaha ka dhigaya codsi mid fudud in la oggolaado iyo qabyada edebta u eg ee weli ku guuldareysta.
x-k-k6-01.material:
Waxaad tahay arday sannad-koowaad jaamacadda. 민준 선배 waa waayeel koox oo saddex sano ka weyn; waxaad la hadashay laba jeer oo keliya. Wuxuu qoray qoraallo fiican casharkii todobaadkii hore. Imtixaankaaga waa berri galabta wuxuuna rabaa inaad aragto qoraallada maanta. Waxaad qortay afar qabyo fariimo ah:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
x-k-k6-01.thinking.0: Isbarbar dhigidda qabyada iyo caddaynta erayada
x-k-k6-01.thinking.1: Kala saaridda heerka edebta iyo waxtarka
x-k-k6-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan -(으)세요 ee ixtiraamka iyo qaabka -아/어요
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.prompt: Adigoo xukumaya erayada oo keliya, qabyadee ayaa ugu badan inay heli doonto 'haa' raalli ah waqtigeeda?
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig yaa qabyo kastaa u egtahay in loo qoray.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qabyo kasta weydii: ma waayeelka siinaysaa hab raaxo leh oo uu ku dhihi karo maya, ma na ogaanayaa goorta aad u baahan tahay?
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ogaatay qaab su'aal oo meel u daayay maya, oo ay la socdaan sabab iyo cadaadis waqti.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay u egtahay hadal u dhexeeya saaxiibo dhow ama amar; hadluhu wuxuu ogaaday imtixaanka laakiin ma ogaan xiriirka.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad si aad u sarreysa u qiimaysay edebta; hubi haddii fariin aad u edeb badan sidoo kale u sheegto akhristaha sida degdega loo baahan yahay.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.d: Dhammaadyada ixtiraamku waa jiraan, laakiin weedha labaad waxay masuuliyadda saaraysaa waayeelka. Hubi sida ay u dareemayso marka la helo.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.explain: Qabyo B waxay weydiisaa haddii ay suurtagal tahay (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), waxay bixisaa sabab, sababtuna waxay muujisaa cadaadiska waqtiga. Qabyo C aad bay u ixtiraam badan tahay laakiin weligeed ma dhaho berri ayaa loo baahan yahay, sidaa darteed waayeelku wuxuu ku jawaabi karaa todobaadka dambe. Qabyo A ma laha dhowaan ixtiraam leh waayeel fog, Qabyo D na waxay cadaadis saaraysaa.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.acc.0: B oo keliya ayaa isku daraya su'aal jilicsan, sabab, iyo waqti kama dambays muuqda.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.prompt: 2-3 weedhood (Ingiriisi ama Kuuriyaan) sharax: (1) erayada Qabyo B ka dhigaya codsi halkii amar, iyo (2) sababta Qabyo C, in kasta oo aad u edeb badan tahay, weli u horseedi karto inaadan qoraallada waqtigeeda helin.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Quote erayada Kuuriyaanka ah ee saxda ah ee Qabyo B ee aad ula jeedo.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qaybta 2, ka fikir inaad tahay waayeelka oo akhri Qabyo C: maxaadan ogayn?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma quoted erayada Kuuriyaanka ee qabyada, ma aha oo keliya inaan idhi 'waa edeb'?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxay dhibaatada C aragtida waayeelka?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma akhriste kale wuxuu kala saari karaa labadayda qodob?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.model.0: Dhammaadka -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요 iyo 혹시 waxay codsiga u beddelaan su'aal ku saabsan suurtagalnimada, sidaa darteed waayeelku si fudud buu u diidi karaa, 시험이라서요 na wuxuu bixiyaa sababta. Qabyo C weligeed ma dhaho berri, sidaa darteed ma ogaan karo inay degdeg tahay oo wuxuu ku jawaabi karaa todobaadka dambe.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.model.1: B gudahiisa su'aasha '보내 주실 수 있을까요?' waxay weydiisaa oggolaansho halkii ay amri lahayd. C waa ixtiraam, laakiin 'goorta aad waqti hesho' wuxuu u sheegayaa inaan degdeg jirin, taasoo ka soo horjeedda xaaladdaada: waqtiga kama dambaysta ah waa berri.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu diiradda saaraa sida akhristuhu u akhrin doono.

x-k-k6-03.title: Kahor intaadan dhihin haa
x-k-k6-03.goal: Go'aami su'aalaha loo baahan yahay kahor intaadan aqbalin casuumaad, iyadoo la tixgelinayo xaddidaadaada, oo qor jawaab si edeb leh u weydiisa.

Fasal-wadaagkaaga 하준, oo aad dhowr jeer la hadashay, ayaa ku soo diray fariintan:

하준: 토요일에 집들이 해요! 우리 집은 학교 앞 서점 옆이에요. 시간 되면 와요~

(집들이 = xaflad guri-furasho.) Waxaad ka ogtahay naftaada: Sabtida waxaad shaqo qeyb-waqti ah ka shaqeysaa ilaa 7:00 p.m. Tareenka dhulka hoostiisa ee ugu dambeeya ee gurigaaga u socda wuxuu ka baxaa saqda dhexe. Waxaad xasaasiyad u leedahay shrimp iyo crab.

Xaalad 2 (qol akhris maktabad): qofka miiska xiga fadhiya ayaa ku jira wicitaan codsare. Isla da', adiga aan la aqoon.
x-k-k6-06.thinking.0: Qiimeynta haddii weedh runtii la jilciyay

x-k-k6-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Midkood ma u dhawaaqaa sida amar?
